entries: The Survival Creator lets players build custom wave-based combat content using enemy placement, wave rules, and supported Creator assets. Rockstar continues expanding available presets and options.

The modern Rockstar Mission Creator lets players build and publish custom missions with objectives, actors, vehicles, interactables, cutscenes, mission flags, and other scripted elements. The 2026 Kortz Center update expanded it further.
The 2026 Creator updates let players nominate up to 16 Player-Created Jobs so nominated content can appear on the Next Job voting screen after other Jobs.

GTA Online runs rotating event periods with changing bonuses, discounts, challenges, and featured activities. Franklin should not quote a current weekly bonus unless it has a current source because these change frequently.
does gta online work on ios port
can i play online on iphone port
Yes. The project's 29 Oct 2026 build adds GTA Online to the launcher. Confirmed features include a custom Online character, free roam, GTA Online Jobs, and friend sessions for up to 32 players.
On the 29 Oct iOS project build, the Online character creator opens the first time. The developer notes list heritage, facial features, hair, clothing by shop name, and supported DLC-pack clothing.
The 29 Oct build includes GTA Online free roam without the Story Mode campaign. The trainer remains available for supported actions.
races deathmatches survivals contact missions ios
On the 29 Oct build, GTA Online races, deathmatches, survivals, and contact missions are launched from Trainer › GTA Online › Jobs.
how many players ios gta online
The 29 Oct project notes state that friend sessions support up to 32 players. These sessions run on the players' own devices rather than project-hosted game servers.
join friend code gta online port
To play with friends anywhere in the 29 Oct build, the host creates a session in Trainer › GTA Online and shares the session code. Friends choose Join and tap ENTER CODE.
Nearby is the local discovery option for players on the same Wi-Fi. Allow Local Network access when iOS asks, otherwise Nearby discovery may not work.

The 29 Oct notes warn that some mobile networks block direct connections. If a friend cannot connect, try Wi-Fi or enable UPnP on the host router, and make sure Local Network permission is allowed on iOS.
host job takes everyone ios gta online
In an iOS project session, when the host starts a supported GTA Online Job, the developer notes say everyone in that session is taken along with the host.
does ios port have all gta online features

Do not assume every feature from Rockstar's official GTA Online is implemented in the iOS project. The confirmed 29 Oct scope is custom characters, free roam, selected GTA Online Jobs, and peer-to-peer friend sessions. Franklin should treat other official GTA Online systems as general reference unless the project notes confirm them.
what data does ios launcher collect
The 29 Oct project notes say the app counts plays anonymously using device model, chip, and system version, and that this count does not include names or accounts.
The 29 Oct build fixes a crash that could happen when changing clothes with DLC packs installed. Update to the 29 Oct build before treating that symptom as an unresolved issue.
blown up race respawn loop ios
The 29 Oct build fixes the respawn loop that could occur after a vehicle was blown up during a race.
upgrade cars one by one trainer
The 29 Oct build lets the Trainer change car upgrades one by one.
The 29 Oct build adds pinch-to-zoom on the pause map.
Touch-button opacity is adjustable in Launcher › HUD & Controls in the 29 Oct build.
In the 29 Oct build, add-on cars without working custom audio use a stock-car sound from the matching vehicle class.
From the 29 Oct build, the launcher opens at every start.
For the 29 Oct update, install the new build over the current installation. The developer notes say existing saves and mods stay as they are.

As of the official Rockstar Support material reviewed for this knowledge pack, GTAV Title Update 1.73 is the current GTA Online title-update line. It includes the 2026 Kortz Center Heist update and later 2026 content/fixes through the October Halloween event period.

The 2026 Kortz Center update changed rewards for several Contact Missions and Heists by adding weekly completion bonus logic and adjusting some repeat-completion rewards. Because these values are economy-sensitive, Franklin should explain the system without quoting stale payout numbers.
